_doc: NPC memory tags (MemoryManager): relationship change, reputation dimensions, lines they may say later.

PLAYER_SAVED_ME.label: You saved their life
lines: You pulled me back once. I haven't forgotten.
Last time I came in here I was dying. Look at me now.

PLAYER_REFUSED_TREATMENT.label: You turned them away
lines: Last time you sent me back out into the rain.
Going to refuse me again, doc?

PLAYER_OVERCHARGED_ME.label: You overcharged them
lines: I'm still paying off what you charged me last time.
Same price as last time? I remember your prices.

PLAYER_GAVE_DISCOUNT.label: You gave them a discount
lines: You went easy on me with the money. I told people.
You cut me a break once. Not many do down here.

PLAYER_TREATED_FREE.label: You treated them for free
lines: You fixed me for nothing. I owe you.
My whole block knows you didn't charge me.

PLAYER_FAILED_OPERATION.label: You botched their operation
lines: My hand still doesn't close right. Your work.
Try not to wreck it this time.

PLAYER_INSTALLED_CYBERWARE.label: You installed their chrome
lines: The chrome you put in still runs smooth.
Came back to the same hands. Your work held.

PLAYER_KILLED_FRIEND.label: Someone they loved died on your table
lines: You're the one who killed my friend.
I know your face. You had them on your table when they died.

PLAYER_BETRAYED_FACTION.label: You sold out their people
lines: You sold my crew to Aegis. Don't pretend.

PLAYER_KEPT_SECRET.label: You kept their secret
lines: You never told anyone what you saw. That matters.

PLAYER_SAVED_EMPLOYEE.label: You stood up for them
lines: You had my back. I won't forget it.

PLAYER_LET_DEBT_GO.label: You wrote off their debt
lines: You let my debt go. I'm paying you back the only way I can: I keep coming here.

PLAYER_SENT_COLLECTOR.label: You sent a collector after them
lines: Your collector broke two of my fingers.
I paid. You didn't have to send them.

PLAYER_FED_DEPENDENCY.label: You fed their chrome hunger
lines: You always give me what I ask for. More.
The last upgrade wasn't enough. It never is.

PLAYER_STABILIZED_ME.label: You talked them down from more chrome
lines: You told me no, last time. I hated you. You were right.

PLAYER_MADE_ME_WAIT.label: You made them wait for hours
lines: Last time I waited half the night in that chair.

PLAYER_REFERRED.label: They sent friends your way
lines: My cousin came here because of me. You treat them right?

PLAYER_HELD_FAVOR.label: They owe you a favour
lines: I still owe you that favour. When you call, I'll come.

PLAYER_STOLE_FROM_ME.label: They think you robbed them
lines: Something was missing from my coat when I left here.

PLAYER_LIED.label: You lied to them
lines: You lied to me before. Why should I believe you now?

PLAYER_KEPT_PROMISE.label: You kept your word
lines: You kept your promise. Rare, down here.

PLAYER_FORCED_MY_HAND.label: You made them cross their own line
lines: You made me do it. I still see that kid's face.
I said no. You didn't listen. I remember that.
